blocks.content: The Data Manipulation Language(DML) adds, updates, and deletes data from a table.

items: INSERT -  rows into a database table
UPDATE - edits data from a table
DELETE - deletes rows from a table

blocks.content: You are already familiar with these from earlier chapters.
